name: agentic-usage-meter-desktop
description: Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) system-tray app showing coding-agent subscription quota windows and balances. Port of the macOS app prime-radiant-inc/agentic-usage-meter.
author: prime-radiant-inc

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
